changeRecord.title: release removed (connection made rigid)
changeRecord.whyItMatters: A pinned or semi-rigid connection modelled as rigid attracts moment it cannot carry in reality: the member becomes continuous with the joint, its span moment drops, and the joint, the column or the neighbouring span receive a moment they were not designed for.
changeRecord.precondition: a member with a release or connection spring at an end
